items.zh: 这片风景如画的土地种满了稻米。
items.en: This whole vast landscape is dominated by rice cultivation.

items.zh: 他先是很困惑，然后十分愤怒，他尝试离开。
items.en: Confused, then indignant, he tries to leave.

items.zh: 西方人的生活会越来越多地被发展的悖论折磨着。
items.en: Increasingly, Western life is afflicted by the paradoxes of progress.

items.zh: 作家饱受战争摧残的童年充斥着不安，给他的作品投下阴影，孕育出黑暗的主题。
items.en: The writer’s war-torn childhood, filled with unrest, cast a shadow over his works and gave rise to his dark theme.

items.zh: 睡姿关乎心脑健康，因此选择一个你感觉最舒适，夜间醒来频率最低的睡姿是明智之举。
items.en: Sleep position is linked to heart and brain health, so it is wise to choose the one where you feel most comfortable and wake up least often at night.
